label: 流墨研究生・向左跑步及待機起停轉跳16格八欄原畫分件

provenance.method: Each own graduate LEFT native pose is independently partitioned. Built-in image_gen provides concealed cloth, underclothes and cap-under hair material. The visible original identity is retained from the same native pose.
provenance.normalIdentity: Own same-cell visible hair/fringe, face/ears/neck and both hands/forearms keep their original nonzero RGBA. Other normal layers clear every nonzero body-front pixel.
provenance.nativeWearables: Original visible wearable RGB is retained; native alpha >=240 is promoted to255, with lower-alpha outlines retained. This does not claim original garment RGBA equality.
provenance.compact: Same-source LANCZOS 0.375 resize with body-front alpha>=248 core protection. No old character border-coordinate cleanup is used.

independentIdentityLandmarks.scope: 128 independently frozen own-native hair/face/ear/neck/hand/forearm probes; sparse points do not replace full body-layer preservation or visual review.

independentGarmentObservations.scope: 112 own-native book/cape-clasp/cape/hat/jacket/pants/shoes observations selected blind to author traces/layers. Author outputs may already have existed; these observations were frozen before comparison against them. Shirt and the independently attached small pin have no forced native LEFT points. Separate from128 identity probes and full boundary semantics.

provenance.frontItems: The own native held book is a handheld pass beneath fixed native hands. The sealed front independent9x15 chest pin is attached by recorded integer translation only; the book and fixed identity naturally occlude it. Original native large green-leaf cape clasps and cape lining remain with the cape.

approvedAccessory.nativeRGBException: Only exact translated pin nonzero-alpha pixels visible after book/body occlusion; fixed native body is never an exception.

provenance.fallback: Only these16 cells and the256 pineapple/null combinations are added. The sealed front idle, graduate UP16 and all other actual-loadout fallback and race-handling code are retained.
provenance.coverageClaimScope: Existing native pose-cell layering only; actual pixel/UI/delivery acceptance is recorded separately.
